speak.title: Role-play: a slower month at home
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: the housemate who wants a slower life
a.text: You've watched videos of two grandmothers baking in Italy. You want your house to try nonnamaxxing this month: cook at home, eat at the table together, no phones at dinner. Persuade your housemate.

b.text: You work long hours and you like quick meals. Say what worries you and ask for something smaller. Try to agree on a plan you can both live with.

phrases: I'd love us to cook together twice a week.
That's a nice idea, but I'm really busy.
What if we start with one dinner?
Could we agree on a day to try it?
I don't mind, as long as we're not too strict.
speak.after: Tell the class: what did you agree, and who gave up more?
